title: Plan peak memory, not only table payload
description: Estimate a DataFrame payload and a transformation peak from explicit row, column, string, and temporary-copy assumptions. The fixture is a capacity envelope, not pandas memory_usage output.

profiles.label: Mostly numeric features
profiles.detail: Fixed-width numeric and boolean columns dominate; validate actual extension and nullable dtypes.

profiles.label: Mixed product features
profiles.detail: Numeric features coexist with repeated strings and identifiers whose representation can dominate memory.

profiles.label: Text-heavy inspection
profiles.detail: Object or string payloads dominate. Projection, categoricals, Arrow-backed types, or another execution engine may change the boundary.

notice: The model budgets 8 bytes per numeric element and a teaching estimate of 8 bytes plus average UTF-8 payload per text element. Real memory depends on dtype, null masks, indexes, Python objects, dictionary encoding, Arrow backing, allocator behavior, Copy-on-Write, operation internals, and pandas version.
